retained_claim_limits.statement: Explain automatic driving prohibition following a missed inspection deadline and applicable conditions for addressing it.
retained_claim_limits.scope_limits: Inträtt körförbud due missed periodic deadline, not dangerous-condition meddelat körförbud. On-road: shortest suitable route to repair workshop/inspection; off-road and still banned: shortest suitable route to nearest inspection business. Does not grant general errands/commuting or waive other requirements. Periodic inspection example only. Inspection being carried out ends §15 deadline ban; not a guarantee the result permits ordinary driving, since defects may create new ban/order. No implication a pass is always required merely to end the original deadline ban. General off-road rule allows shortest suitable route to/from nearest inspection; when an overdue ban also applies, the additional ban restriction is to nearest inspection. Return is not automatically allowed while that ban continues. This is an explicit intersection of the agency conditions.
